concerns.text: Task T013 lists 'Entropy, POS, Position, KenLM perplexity' but omits 'local semantic density' which is explicitly required by FR-003 and SC-001. This is a semantic weakening of the feature set required to validate the static heuristic hypothesis.

FR-008 and Constitution Principle VI mandate evaluating the Learned Sparse baseline over 5 independent random seeds. T026a describes generating per-document results but fails to explicitly mandate the execution of 5 distinct training/inference runs or the storage of seed-specific artifacts required for the paired t-test in T029. Without explicit 5-seed execution, the statistical comparison is invalid.

Constitution Principle VI and FR-009 require a falsifiability check against a <1% performance drop threshold. T031 calculates the drop but lacks a safeguard for division-by-zero or near-zero baselines (if Learned Mean is ~0), which would cause the pipeline to crash or produce undefined results, violating the robustness required for the falsifiability check.

FR-004 requires training over 5 seeds to estimate variance. T019c aggregates scores but does not explicitly require calculating and storing the variance/standard deviation across seeds. SC-001 requires measuring predictor stability, which necessitates variance data, not just the mean.
